categories.main_business_segments: Ogaki Kyoritsu Bank, Ltd. (OKB) operates primarily in banking, with additional segments in leasing, credit guarantee, and other financial services. The banking segment includes deposit-taking, lending, domestic and foreign exchange, securities investment, and sales of investment trusts and insurance. The group also provides leasing through Koyuu Lease, credit guarantees via OKB Credit Guarantee, and other services such as IT, securities, credit cards, and venture capital through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: OKB leverages advanced digital banking technologies, including biometric authentication ATMs and web-based loan contracts, to enhance customer convenience and operational efficiency. The bank utilizes robust risk management systems, ALM (Asset Liability Management), and integrated IT infrastructure for transaction processing, compliance, and internal controls. Continuous investment in digital transformation (DX) and process automation is a key feature of its operational methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The bank primarily serves individual and corporate customers in the Tokai region, especially small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), local governments, and retail clients. Its customer base includes manufacturers, service providers, public sector entities, and individuals seeking retail banking, loans, and asset management products. The bank also supports local businesses with consulting, M&A, and sustainability solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: OKB's core operations are concentrated in Gifu and Aichi prefectures, with an extensive branch network in the Tokai region (including Mie and Shiga), and additional branches in major cities such as Tokyo and Osaka. The group also maintains overseas representative offices in Shanghai and Manila to support clients with international business needs.
categories.supply_chain_position: OKB operates as a downstream financial services provider, directly interfacing with end customers (individuals, corporations, and public entities) by offering banking, leasing, and financial solutions. It acts as a financial intermediary, channeling deposits into loans and investments, and providing related services such as guarantees and consulting.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The bank's strategic priorities include strengthening core lending and deposit businesses in a rising interest rate environment, accelerating digital transformation (DX), and supporting regional sustainability and decarbonization. Key initiatives involve enhancing SME support, promoting open innovation, investing in human capital and diversity, and expanding sustainable finance and consulting for local communities. The bank is also focused on improving capital efficiency and shareholder returns.
categories.revenue_model: OKB generates revenue primarily through interest income from loans and securities investments, as well as fees from settlement, foreign exchange, asset management, insurance sales, leasing, and credit guarantees. Additional income streams include securities trading, consulting, and various financial services provided by group subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: OKB is a leading regional bank in the Tokai area, competing with other regional banks such as Juroku Bank, Shizuoka Bank, and national banks with local presence. It differentiates itself through strong local ties, comprehensive financial services, and a focus on digital innovation and sustainability. The bank maintains a solid market position among regional financial institutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of March 2025, OKB reported consolidated total assets of approximately 6.54 trillion yen and net assets of 318.5 billion yen. FY2024 consolidated ordinary income was 131.4 billion yen, with net profit attributable to shareholders of 14.7 billion yen, reflecting strong growth in profitability and capital ratios. The bank has shown resilience and steady improvement in earnings, with a focus on sustainable growth and capital efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: OKB emphasizes its role as a trusted regional financial partner, offering comprehensive, customer-centric solutions tailored to local needs. Its value proposition includes advanced digital services, strong community engagement, support for regional innovation and sustainability, and a commitment to diversity and human capital development. The bank differentiates itself through its integrated financial services, digital transformation, and proactive support for local economic and environmental challenges.
